integrity: Original source statements checked against their exact mathematical implications; proof is self-contained, computational tests finite; unlocated equivalent coverage remains a risk.
scientific_limitations: Only two distinct prime factors with one dyadic exponent and a singleton cofactor; does not settle global infinitude. Small dyadic exponents through 32 were covered by a prior finite classification; new implication is unbounded dyadic exponents at least 64.
title: Dyadic-exponent rigidity for equality of unitary and exponential divisor sums
